Title: No server-side input size limit and no rate limiting on anonymous POST /api/tts
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send POST /api/tts with any X-Session-Id and a 60,000-character text. 2. Send 40+ requests in one minute from one IP.
Expected Result: Requests above a documented size are rejected with 413/400; per-IP rate limit returns 429.
Actual Result: 60,000 chars accepted and processed for 45 s before timing out; 43 production requests in ~1 minute all served; no limiter in code or nginx.
Root Cause: Confirmed: no length check or limiter exists anywhere in the request path.
Recommended Fix: Enforce MAX_CHARS (e.g. 5,000 per request) in api_tts and in the UI counter; add nginx limit_req (e.g. 10 r/min per IP, burst 5) on /api/tts; lower client_max_body_size to 256k.
Fix Status: Fixed on fix/day1-abuse-availability (not deployed): 5,000-char limit in API + UI; nginx 20 r/min/IP burst 10, 64k body

Title: Break markers amplify a tiny request into unbounded audio and ffmpeg work
Steps to Reproduce: 1. POST /api/tts with text = '[break:30s]' repeated 60 times + ' ok' (663 chars).
Expected Result: Total silence and segment count are capped; request rejected.
Actual Result: 200 after 8.9 s; produced a 1,801.6 s (30 min) MP3; 60 ffmpeg subprocesses spawned. Each marker is capped at 30 s but their number and total are not.
Recommended Fix: Cap total silence (e.g. 60 s) and segment count (e.g. 50) and return 400; generate silence once and reuse it.
Fix Status: Fixed (not deployed): max 60 s total pause, max 50 segments

Title: Long text fails with a 502 timeout although the site promises no fixed limit
Affected URL / Component: server.py:233-234 (asyncio.wait_for timeout=45); FAQ in web/index.html:297; web/llms.txt
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Paste 20,000 characters (~3,300 words) of English text. 2. Click Generate Audio.
Expected Result: Audio is produced, or the UI states the real limit before submit.
Actual Result: 502 'Synthesis failed: TimeoutError' after 45.07 s (20k) and 45.0 s (60k). 6,000 chars took 39.7 s (5 s margin) while 10,000 took 23.0 s, so the failure point varies with provider latency.
Evidence: evidence/local_stress.json; Local run log in AUTOMATION_COVERAGE_REPORT.md
Root Cause: Confirmed: the whole text is one edge-tts call bounded by a fixed 45 s timeout.
Recommended Fix: Split text server-side into sentence-aligned chunks of about 2,000 chars, synthesize them sequentially (each with its own timeout) and concatenate; publish a hard limit (TTS-BUG-001) and update FAQ/llms.txt.
Regression Test Required: Yes: unit test for chunking + one staging integration test at the limit
Fix Status: In Progress: limit now enforced and documented (5,000); chunked synthesis still needed, as 6,000 chars took 39.7 s vs the 45 s timeout

Title: Blocking ffmpeg/ffprobe calls inside async handler stall every other user
Affected URL / Component: server.py:169-183 and 266-287 (subprocess.run in async def api_tts)
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Start a POST /api/tts with 60 break markers. 2. Poll GET /api/health every 250 ms during the request.
Expected Result: Health stays below 100 ms.
Actual Result: Health latency up to 5.9 s; only 3 of about 36 polls completed during the 8.9 s request.
Root Cause: Confirmed: synchronous subprocess.run inside the event loop, with a single uvicorn worker (deploy/voxly.service).
Recommended Fix: Use asyncio.create_subprocess_exec or run_in_threadpool for ffmpeg/ffprobe; run 2-4 uvicorn workers.
Regression Test Required: Yes: async test that /api/health answers in <200 ms during a long generation
Fix Status: Fixed (not deployed): ffmpeg/ffprobe via asyncio.to_thread; uvicorn --workers 2

Title: SRT/VTT subtitles are estimated, not word-timed as advertised
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Generate any text. 2. Download SRT. 3. Inspect: the last cue ends exactly at the file duration, and cue boundaries are proportional to character counts.
Expected Result: Cues use the engine's word offsets.
Actual Result: edge-tts 7.x defaults to boundary='SentenceBoundary'; the stream contained {'audio': 49, 'SentenceBoundary': 2} and no WordBoundary, so the code always falls back to proportional estimation.
Evidence: evidence/subtitles/para_en.srt; local stream inspection in AI_AUDIO_QUALITY_REPORT.md
Recommended Fix: Pass boundary='WordBoundary' to edge_tts.Communicate (or consume SentenceBoundary events); keep the estimate only as a fallback.

Title: Typing during a generation re-enables Generate and allows duplicate jobs
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Type text and click Generate Audio. 2. While 'Generating…' shows, type one character. 3. Click Generate Audio again.
Expected Result: Button stays disabled until the job finishes; one request.
Actual Result: Button re-enabled mid-job; 2 /api/tts requests sent for one intended generation.
Root Cause: Confirmed: the input handler calls updateCounter(), which sets disabled from text emptiness and ignores in-flight state.
Recommended Fix: Keep a 'busy' flag; updateCounter must respect it; optionally abort the previous fetch with AbortController.

Title: Language/voice mismatch returns a cryptic 502 and the UI blames the network
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Keep an English voice. 2. Enter Hindi text 'सुप्रभात। आज मौसम बहुत सुहावना है।' 3. Generate.
Expected Result: Speech, or a message telling the user to pick a voice matching the text language.
Actual Result: HTTP 502 'Synthesis failed: NoAudioReceived: No audio was received...'; toast appends 'the speech service may be unreachable from this network right now'. The same suffix is shown for 400 validation errors.
Root Cause: Confirmed: provider rejects script/voice mismatch; server forwards raw exception text; client appends a fixed network message.
Recommended Fix: Map NoAudioReceived to 422 'This voice cannot read the text's language — choose a matching Voice Language'; show server detail without the network suffix for 4xx.
Regression Test Required: Yes: API test for mapped error + UI toast text
Fix Status: Fixed (not deployed): NoAudioReceived -> 422 with Voice Language guidance; UI shows 4xx detail without network suffix

Expected Result: 4xx with a validation message.

Fix Status: Fixed (not deployed): Pydantic request model; validation -> 422 with one readable message

Title: Privacy and marketing statements don't match actual behaviour
Affected URL / Component: web/privacy.html; cookie banner index.html:327-331; web/llms.txt; FAQ index.html:298-300
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Accept cookies and inspect document.cookie and network. 2. Read the privacy policy and llms.txt.
Expected Result: Disclosures match behaviour.
Actual Result: Banner and policy claim analytics cookies, but no analytics code exists and no cookies are set. The policy does not name Microsoft (Edge speech service) as the processor receiving user text. llms.txt says the tool 'runs entirely in the browser' (it is server-side). FAQ/llms.txt promise 'word-level timings' (TTS-BUG-005) and 'special symbols cleaned up' (emoji are read aloud).
Recommended Fix: Remove the cookie banner or add the analytics it describes; name Microsoft as sub-processor and state retention; correct llms.txt and FAQ claims.
Regression Test Required: Manual review on each content change
Fix Status: In Progress: llms.txt limit and 'runs entirely in the browser' corrected; privacy/cookie copy still open

Title: Speed/pitch number box desyncs from the value sent; server doesn't clamp speed; pitch '%' is actually Hz

Title: GET /api/file creates a directory for any session id; retention cleanup runs only on new generations
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Send 25 GET /api/file/x.mp3?s=<random> requests.
Expected Result: No server state created by a read.
Actual Result: 25 new directories created; cleanup only runs inside /api/tts, so expired files persist on an idle server.
Recommended Fix: Split _session_dir into a read path (no mkdir) and a write path; run cleanup on a periodic background task.

Title: Missing security headers, exposed API docs, verbose errors, cross-site POST accepted
Affected URL / Component: nginx config; FastAPI app (server.py:45); error handler server.py:260
Steps to Reproduce: 1. curl -D - https://text-2-speech.com/. 2. GET /docs. 3. Trigger a provider error. 4. POST text/plain from another Origin.
Expected Result: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy present; docs hidden; generic errors; cross-site requests rejected.
Actual Result: No security headers; 'Server: nginx/1.28.3 (Ubuntu)' disclosed; /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json return 200; raw exception text returned; cross-origin text/plain POST returns 200.
Recommended Fix: Add headers in nginx (server_tokens off); FastAPI(docs_url=None, redoc_url=None, openapi_url=None); log exceptions and return a generic detail; require Content-Type application/json and check Origin on POST.
Regression Test Required: Yes: header check in CI smoke test
Fix Status: Fixed (not deployed): security headers in app, docs disabled, generic 5xx detail, JSON-only body; nginx server_tokens off
